_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Provider list prices change over time - verify
against the provider's pricing page before trusting the cost dashboard.
Lookup is exact-match first, then longest-prefix match, so a dated model
For a model that is not listed here, set LLM_PRICE_INPUT / LLM_PRICE_OUTPUT
in .env; otherwise cost is reported as unknown rather than as $0.
